title: Most people think the most dangerous moment is when someone falls into sin.
paragraphs: Most people think the most dangerous moment is when someone falls into sin.
The most dangerous moment is when conviction stops bothering them.

When the warning inside grows quiet.
When the heart stops trembling.
When sin no longer feels heavy.

“Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
— Hebrews 3:15

A hardened heart rarely happens overnight.
It forms slowly — ignored conviction after ignored conviction.
But if you still feel conviction today…

Question:
Have you ever felt God warning your heart about something?
